fever.title: Fever Awareness
fever.symptoms: High body temperature, chills, sweating, weakness, headache, body ache.
fever.prevention: Maintain good hygiene, drink plenty of fluids, get adequate rest, and avoid close contact with infected individuals.
fever.when_to_seek_help: If fever crosses 102°F, lasts more than 3 days, or is accompanied by severe weakness, breathing difficulty, or confusion.
fever.advice: Monitor your temperature regularly, stay hydrated, and rest. Consult a healthcare professional if symptoms worsen or persist.
fever.disclaimer: This information is for awareness purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice.

cold.title: Common Cold Awareness
cold.symptoms: Runny or blocked nose, sneezing, mild sore throat, watery eyes, mild fatigue.
cold.prevention: Wash hands frequently, avoid touching the face, stay warm, and maintain a healthy diet to support immunity.
cold.when_to_seek_help: If symptoms last more than 10 days or are accompanied by high fever or breathing difficulty.
cold.advice: Rest well, drink warm fluids, and allow the body time to recover naturally.
cold.disclaimer: This information is for awareness purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice.

cough.title: Cough Awareness
cough.symptoms: Dry or wet cough, throat irritation, occasional chest discomfort.
cough.prevention: Avoid smoke and dust exposure, stay hydrated, and maintain good respiratory hygiene by covering the mouth while coughing.
cough.when_to_seek_help: If cough persists beyond two weeks, produces blood, or is accompanied by chest pain or breathlessness.
cough.advice: Use warm fluids and steam inhalation for comfort. Seek medical evaluation if the cough does not improve.
cough.disclaimer: This information is for awareness purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice.

headache.title: Headache Awareness
headache.symptoms: Pain or pressure in the head, sensitivity to light or sound, mild nausea.
headache.prevention: Stay hydrated, maintain regular sleep, reduce screen strain, and manage stress levels.
headache.when_to_seek_help: If headache is sudden and severe, follows an injury, or comes with vision changes, vomiting, or confusion.
headache.advice: Rest in a quiet, dark space and avoid excessive screen exposure. Consult a doctor for frequent or severe headaches.
headache.disclaimer: This information is for awareness purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice.

sore throat.title: Sore Throat Awareness
sore throat.symptoms: Throat pain, scratchiness, difficulty swallowing, mild swelling.
sore throat.prevention: Avoid cold drinks, maintain hydration, and practice good oral hygiene.
sore throat.when_to_seek_help: If pain is severe, lasts more than a week, or is accompanied by high fever or difficulty breathing.
sore throat.advice: Gargle with warm salt water and stay hydrated. Seek medical advice if symptoms do not improve.
sore throat.disclaimer: This information is for awareness purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice.

dehydration.title: Dehydration Awareness
dehydration.symptoms: Dry mouth, dizziness, fatigue, reduced urination, dark-colored urine.
dehydration.prevention: Drink water regularly, especially in hot weather or during illness, and consume fluids with electrolytes when needed.
dehydration.when_to_seek_help: If there is severe dizziness, fainting, very low urination, or rapid heartbeat.
dehydration.advice: Increase fluid intake gradually and rest in a cool environment. Seek medical attention if symptoms are severe.
dehydration.disclaimer: This information is for awareness purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice.

diarrhea.title: Diarrhea Awareness
diarrhea.symptoms: Frequent loose or watery stools, abdominal cramps, urgency.
diarrhea.prevention: Maintain food and water hygiene, wash hands before eating, and avoid contaminated food or water sources.
diarrhea.when_to_seek_help: If diarrhea persists more than 2 days, contains blood, or is accompanied by signs of dehydration.
diarrhea.advice: Stay hydrated with oral fluids and rest. Consult a doctor if symptoms worsen or persist.
diarrhea.disclaimer: This information is for awareness purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice.

vomiting.title: Vomiting Awareness
vomiting.symptoms: Nausea, repeated vomiting, stomach discomfort, weakness.
vomiting.prevention: Avoid spoiled or contaminated food, eat smaller meals, and maintain proper food hygiene.
vomiting.when_to_seek_help: If vomiting is persistent, contains blood, or is accompanied by severe abdominal pain or dehydration.
vomiting.advice: Sip fluids slowly and rest. Seek medical care if vomiting continues or worsens.
vomiting.disclaimer: This information is for awareness purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice.

dengue.title: Dengue Awareness
dengue.symptoms: High fever, severe headache, joint and muscle pain, skin rash, fatigue.
dengue.prevention: Eliminate stagnant water, use mosquito repellents, and wear protective clothing to avoid mosquito bites.
dengue.when_to_seek_help: If there is severe abdominal pain, bleeding, persistent vomiting, or difficulty breathing.
dengue.advice: Rest, stay hydrated, and monitor symptoms closely. Seek prompt medical attention for proper evaluation.
dengue.disclaimer: This information is for awareness purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice.

malaria.title: Malaria Awareness
malaria.symptoms: Fever with chills, sweating, headache, fatigue, and muscle pain occurring in cycles.
malaria.prevention: Use mosquito nets and repellents, eliminate breeding sites, and avoid outdoor exposure during peak mosquito hours.
malaria.when_to_seek_help: If fever is recurring, high, or accompanied by confusion, severe weakness, or difficulty breathing.
malaria.advice: Seek timely medical evaluation for fever with chills, especially in malaria-prone areas.
malaria.disclaimer: This information is for awareness purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice.

covid.title: COVID-19 Awareness
covid.symptoms: Fever, cough, fatigue, loss of taste or smell, breathlessness in some cases.
covid.prevention: Maintain hand hygiene, wear masks in crowded places, ensure proper ventilation, and follow vaccination guidelines.
covid.when_to_seek_help: If breathing difficulty, chest pain, low oxygen levels, or confusion occurs.
covid.advice: Isolate if symptomatic, monitor oxygen levels, and stay hydrated. Seek immediate care for severe symptoms.
covid.disclaimer: This information is for awareness purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice.

diabetes.title: Diabetes Awareness
diabetes.symptoms: Increased thirst, frequent urination, fatigue, blurred vision, slow healing of wounds.
diabetes.prevention: Maintain a balanced diet, exercise regularly, manage body weight, and monitor blood sugar levels periodically.
diabetes.when_to_seek_help: If experiencing extreme thirst, rapid weight loss, confusion, or very high or low blood sugar symptoms.
diabetes.advice: Follow a healthy lifestyle and have regular checkups. Consult a doctor for personalized management.
diabetes.disclaimer: This information is for awareness purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice.

bp.title: High Blood Pressure Awareness
bp.symptoms: Often no symptoms; some may experience headache, dizziness, or fatigue.
bp.prevention: Reduce salt intake, exercise regularly, manage stress, avoid tobacco, and monitor blood pressure periodically.
bp.when_to_seek_help: If experiencing severe headache, chest pain, vision changes, or very high readings.
bp.advice: Maintain a healthy lifestyle and monitor blood pressure regularly. Consult a doctor for proper evaluation.
bp.disclaimer: This information is for awareness purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice.

anemia.title: Anemia Awareness
anemia.symptoms: Fatigue, weakness, pale skin, dizziness, shortness of breath.
anemia.prevention: Eat iron-rich foods, maintain a balanced diet, and have regular health checkups, especially for at-risk groups.
anemia.when_to_seek_help: If experiencing severe fatigue, rapid heartbeat, or breathlessness during normal activity.
anemia.advice: Maintain proper nutrition and consult a healthcare provider for evaluation and guidance.
anemia.disclaimer: This information is for awareness purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice.

asthma.title: Asthma Awareness
asthma.symptoms: Wheezing, shortness of breath, chest tightness, persistent cough.
asthma.prevention: Avoid known triggers such as dust, smoke, and allergens, and maintain a clean living environment.
asthma.when_to_seek_help: If breathing difficulty is severe, lips or face turn bluish, or symptoms do not improve with usual measures.
asthma.advice: Identify and avoid triggers, and follow up regularly with a healthcare professional for management.
asthma.disclaimer: This information is for awareness purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice.

skin allergy.title: Skin Allergy Awareness
skin allergy.symptoms: Redness, itching, rashes, swelling, or irritation on the skin.
skin allergy.prevention: Avoid known allergens, maintain skin hygiene, and use mild, non-irritating skincare products.
skin allergy.when_to_seek_help: If swelling spreads rapidly, breathing becomes difficult, or symptoms worsen significantly.
skin allergy.advice: Avoid scratching the affected area and identify possible triggers. Consult a doctor if symptoms persist.
skin allergy.disclaimer: This information is for awareness purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice.

heatstroke.title: Heatstroke Awareness
heatstroke.symptoms: High body temperature, confusion, rapid pulse, dry skin, dizziness, or fainting.
heatstroke.prevention: Avoid prolonged sun exposure, stay hydrated, wear light clothing, and avoid outdoor activity during peak heat hours.
heatstroke.when_to_seek_help: If confusion, fainting, or very high body temperature occurs, as this can be a medical emergency.
heatstroke.advice: Move to a cool place, hydrate, and seek emergency medical care immediately if symptoms are severe.
heatstroke.disclaimer: This information is for awareness purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice.

flu.title: Seasonal Flu Awareness
flu.symptoms: Fever, body ache, fatigue, cough, sore throat, and runny nose.
flu.prevention: Practice good hand hygiene, avoid close contact with infected individuals, and consider seasonal vaccination.
flu.when_to_seek_help: If symptoms are severe, persist beyond a week, or breathing difficulty develops.
flu.advice: Rest, stay hydrated, and allow the body to recover. Consult a doctor if symptoms worsen.
flu.disclaimer: This information is for awareness purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice.
